key.name: smart-names
key.summary: Give a workspace the name last used for the apps on it

key.name: names-map
key.summary: Smart-name associations: JSON {wmClass: [names]} (same format as space-bar's workspace-names-map)

key.name: active-style
key.summary: Active workspace: the accent colour, or white on the dark top bar

key.name: scroll-wrap
key.summary: Scrolling past the last workspace wraps to the first

key.name: show-empty
key.summary: Show workspaces with no windows (the active one always shows)

key.name: indicator-style
key.summary: Show a pill for every workspace, or only the current one

key.name: show-icons
key.summary: Small icons of the apps on each workspace, next to its name

key.name: move-workspace-left
key.summary: Shortcut: move the current workspace left

key.name: move-workspace-right
key.summary: Shortcut: move the current workspace right
